sentences.en: Wealthy Republican donors were making calls to the majority leader, all advocating for this thing to be done and to be done before the end of the year.
sentences.zh: 富有的共和党捐款人纷纷致电多数党领袖，都在呼吁完成这件事，并且要在年底前完成。

sentences.en: And what we saw today was that that pressure and the support that the senators were building in terms of Republicans saying they would vote for this bill reached a critical mass.
sentences.zh: 我们今天看到的是，这种压力以及参议员们在共和党人中建立的支持——即他们会投票支持该法案——达到了临界点。

sentences.en: And Senator McConnell said, I can't stand in the way of this anymore.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔参议员说，我不能再阻碍这件事了。

sentences.en: So what is a version of criminal justice reform that has this bipartisan support actually look like?
sentences.zh: 那么，获得这种两党支持的刑事司法改革版本到底是什么样的？

sentences.en: What will actually be in this bill that senators are likely to be voting on?
sentences.zh: 参议员们可能投票支持的法案中到底会包含什么？

sentences.en: So the broad strokes of this bill include kind of three different buckets of changes to the criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 这项法案的大致内容包括对刑事司法系统的三个不同方面的改革。

sentences.en: The first is creating a whole new batch of programs and putting money to fund them to basically prepare inmates and federal prisoners for life on the outside.
sentences.zh: 第一是创建一批全新的项目并投入资金，基本上是为了让囚犯和联邦监狱服刑人员为外面的生活做好准备。

sentences.en: So these are job training prograMs.
sentences.zh: 所以这些是职业培训项目。

sentences.en: Some of them are faith-based prograMs.
sentences.zh: 其中一些是基于信仰的项目。

sentences.en: They're designed to try and ensure that people don't recommit crimes and come back into the prison system.
sentences.zh: 它们旨在确保人们不会再次犯罪并回到监狱系统中。

sentences.en: The second bucket are expansions of good behavior and early release prograMs.
sentences.zh: 第二个方面是扩大良好行为和提前释放项目。

sentences.en: So this incentivizes people for taking part in bucket number one, for good behavior, for other things that they do while they're in prison to prepare themselves for life after,
sentences.zh: 所以这激励人们参与第一类项目，保持良好行为，以及他们在监狱中为以后的生活所做的其他准备工作，

sentences.en: and says we'll shave time off the end of your sentence if you do these things.
sentences.zh: 并规定如果你做了这些事情，我们将缩短你的刑期。

sentences.en: And then the third bucket is the set of changes to federal sentencing laws.
sentences.zh: 第三个方面是对联邦量刑法律的一系列修改。

sentences.en: So one of these, for instance, lowers mandatory minimum sentences for nonviolent drug offenders
sentences.zh: 例如，其中之一降低了非暴力毒品犯罪者的强制性最低刑期，

sentences.en: and gets rid of the so-called three strikes you're out penalty where with three convictions you're automatically in jail for life.
sentences.zh: 并废除了所谓的“三振出局”惩罚，即三次定罪后自动终身监禁。

sentences.en: Another is a provision that makes retroactive changes that were passed into law a few years ago
sentences.zh: 另一个条款是对几年前通过的法律进行追溯性修改，

sentences.en: that more equalize the disparity between the way the federal government penalizes offenders with crack versus powder cocaine.
sentences.zh: 这使得联邦政府惩罚快克可卡因与粉末可卡因罪犯的方式更加平等。

sentences.en: And this is an issue that in particular has led to a big racial disparity in the way that cocaine users or people in possession of cocaine were punished in the federal system.
sentences.zh: 这是一个特别导致了联邦系统中可卡因使用者或持有可卡因者在惩罚方面存在巨大种族差异的问题。

sentences.en: Then there are a host of other kind of smaller pieces that have been thrown on here about trying to get prisoners into facilities closer to where they live.
sentences.zh: 此外，还有许多其他较小的条款被加入其中，关于试图将囚犯安置在离他们居住地更近的设施中。

sentences.en: Provisions that ban, in almost all cases, the shackling of pregnant women.
sentences.zh: 在几乎所有情况下禁止给孕妇戴镣铐的条款。

sentences.en: Solitary confinement for juveniles.
sentences.zh: 针对未成年人的单独监禁。

sentences.en: Things like that that have kind of existed in the criminal justice system and there's a consensus are wrong or unethical but needed to be addressed.
sentences.zh: 诸如此类在刑事司法系统中存在，且人们一致认为错误或不道德但需要解决的事情。

sentences.en: And so this is the venue where that is happening.
sentences.zh: 这就是正在发生这一切的现场。

sentences.en: And you've been on the Hill today since McConnell surprised everyone by moving this forward.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔今天出人意料地推动了这项议程，而你今天一直都在国会山。

sentences.en: How are lawmakers on both sides talking about this bill?
sentences.zh: 两党议员是如何看待这项法案的？

sentences.en: So on the Hill these days, almost every issue is Republicans versus Democrats.
sentences.zh: 如今在国会山，几乎每个议题都是共和党与民主党的对立。

sentences.en: On this one, it is Democrats plus about half or a little more than half of Republicans.
sentences.zh: 但在这一议题上，支持者是民主党加上大约一半或略多于一半的共和党人。

sentences.en: And then a group of conservative Republicans who are deeply opposed to these set of changes.
sentences.zh: 还有一群坚决反对这些改革措施的保守派共和党人。

sentences.en: So on the one hand, you have folks who have been working for literally five, six years to try and see these changes that are thrilled.
sentences.zh: 所以一方面，那些真正为推动这些变革努力了五六年的人感到非常激动。

sentences.en: This is the first time in a significant way we're stopping the moving in the wrong direction and turning around and taking a step.
sentences.zh: 这是我们第一次以重大方式阻止了错误方向的推进，并开始扭转局面，迈出了一步。

sentences.en: It's not all the way there, but taking a step in the right direction to begin to correct for the ills of the last 25, 30 years.
sentences.zh: 虽然还没完全实现目标，但这是朝着正确方向迈出的一步，开始纠正过去25到30年来的弊病。

sentences.en: Talking about a historic change that's going to begin to halt and turn around what they see as a phenomenon of mass incarceration, civil rights issue.
sentences.zh: 这谈论的是一场历史性的变革，它将开始遏制并扭转他们所认为的大规模监禁现象，这是一个民权问题。

sentences.en: I went to law school in 1994, the same year that they passed the tough on crime bill here, and that just exploded the American criminal justice system.
sentences.zh: 我1994年上法学院，那一年他们通过了严厉打击犯罪的法案，这彻底引爆了美国的刑事司法系统。

sentences.en: While our roads and bridges and tunnels have been crumbling, we were building, between the time I was in law school and the time I was mayor of the city of Newark,
sentences.zh: 当我们的道路、桥梁和隧道都在破败时，从我上法学院到我担任纽瓦克市长期间，我们一直在建设，

sentences.en: we were building a new prison about every 10 days.
sentences.zh: 我们大约每10天就新建一座监狱。

sentences.en: You know, they're talking about this in big historic terMs.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们正以宏大的历史视角来谈论这件事。

sentences.en: If anything, we should be cracking down on drug dealers.
sentences.zh: 如果说有什么的话，我们应该严厉打击毒贩。

sentences.en: I've got legislation that would increase mandatory minimums for fentanyl,
sentences.zh: 我有一项立法，旨在提高芬太尼的强制最低刑期，

sentences.en: would also overturn a Supreme Court decision from just three years ago that let many violent felons back onto the streets, armed career criminals.
sentences.zh: 同时也将推翻三年前最高法院的一项裁决，该裁决让许多暴力重罪犯和武装职业罪犯重返街头。

sentences.en: On the other side, you have people the most vocal is Senator Tom Cotton, a Republican of Arkansas, a young Republican who usually has the president's ear,
sentences.zh: 而在另一方，最直言不讳的是阿肯色州共和党参议员汤姆·科顿，他是一位通常能得到总统青睐的年轻共和党人，

sentences.en: who is not pleased at all, who tends to speak in terms that are a little bit old school for Republicans.
sentences.zh: 他对此一点也不满意，他倾向于用一些对共和党人来说有点老派的措辞来表达。

sentences.en: It just stands to reason when most prisoners, when released from prison, commit future crimes, that if we let more prisoners out or shorten their sentences,
sentences.zh: 这显而易见，当大多数囚犯获释后会再次犯罪时，如果我们释放更多囚犯或缩短他们的刑期，

sentences.en: you're going to see an increase in crime in this country.
sentences.zh: 你就会看到这个国家的犯罪率上升。

sentences.en: He's made the argument that Republicans could potentially lose seats in primaries over this, that this is a bad vote for them to take,
sentences.zh: 他认为共和党人可能会因此在初选中失去席位，这对他们来说是一次糟糕的投票，

sentences.en: and that they're not making their community safer, they're making them more dangerous.
sentences.zh: 而且他们并没有让社区变得更安全，反而让社区变得更危险了。

sentences.en: And there are a number of other senators who agree with that, but he's kind of the most vocal critic of the bill.
sentences.zh: 还有许多其他参议员也同意这一点，但他算是该法案最直言不讳的批评者。

sentences.en: And how are Republican leaders trying to win over Republicans like Tom Cotton?
sentences.zh: 共和党领导人是如何试图争取像汤姆·科顿这样的共和党人的？

sentences.en: People like Tom Cotton are never going to vote for this bill, but there's a class of Republicans kind of in the middle, and we don't know exactly how many they are,
sentences.zh: 像汤姆·科顿这样的人永远不会投票支持这项法案，但中间还有一类共和党人，我们不确定具体有多少人，

sentences.en: who are wavering, who I think want to be supportive of the bill, or they've indicated that they want to be supportive to the bill, but they need some cover.
sentences.zh: 他们态度摇摆，我认为他们想要支持这项法案，或者他们已经表示想要支持，但他们需要一些掩护。

sentences.en: So, President Trump has been hugely important to providing that.
sentences.zh: 所以，特朗普总统在提供这种掩护方面发挥了巨大的作用。

sentences.en: Fox, the parent company of Fox News, came out with a pretty extraordinary statement endorsing the bill, which is something they don't usually do.
sentences.zh: 福克斯新闻的母公司福克斯发布了一份非常不同寻常的声明，公开支持该法案，这是他们通常不会做的事情。

sentences.en: This struck us as unusual, so we went back and did some reporting and found that the White House had actually put some pressure on Fox to put this together.
sentences.zh: 这让我们觉得很不寻常，所以我们回去做了一些调查，发现白宫实际上向福克斯施压，要求他们发布这份声明。

sentences.en: And the statement that was released late last week had the signature on it of Hope Hicks, who was the former White House communications director and longtime Trump aide,
sentences.zh: 上周晚些时候发布的这份声明上有霍普·希克斯的签名，她是前白宫通讯联络主任和长期的特朗普助手，

sentences.en: who's now the head of communications at Fox, and it was her first statement in that new job.
sentences.zh: 她现在是福克斯的通讯主管，这是她担任新职后的第一份声明。

sentences.en: So, cover, meaning protecting senators who are concerned about backlash from conservative constituents, and the idea being that if Fox tells its audience that this is okay,
sentences.zh: 所以，所谓的掩护，是指保护那些担心保守派选民反弹的参议员，其想法是如果福克斯告诉观众这没问题，

sentences.en: voters are less likely to see it as a betrayal of conservative values.
sentences.zh: 选民就不太可能将其视为对保守派价值观的背叛。

sentences.en: Actually, no, it's less about Fox News telling their audience that it's okay proactively, because they haven't done that explicitly.
sentences.zh: 其实不然，这与其说是福克斯新闻主动告诉观众这没问题，因为他们并没有明确这样做，

sentences.en: It's about the parent company for Fox News sending a kind of signal directly to senators that, don't worry, we're not going to go after you on this issue.
sentences.zh: 不如说是福克斯的母公司直接向参议员们发出了一种信号：别担心，我们不会在这个问题上找你们麻烦。

sentences.en: It's okay for you to take this vote, and our network's not going to make a problem for you, which is a pretty remarkable thing.
sentences.zh: 你们进行这次投票是可以的，我们的电视网不会给你们制造麻烦，这确实是一件非常了不起的事情。

sentences.en: And after that, you saw a kind of flood of these conservatives who are perhaps unlikely allies, Ted Cruz of Texas, David Perdue of Georgia, come out and support this bill.
sentences.zh: 在那之后，你看到了一大批保守派人士，他们或许是意想不到的盟友，比如德克萨斯州的泰德·克鲁兹、乔治亚州的大卫·珀杜，都出来支持这项法案。

sentences.en: So, what about McConnell himself?
sentences.zh: 那么，麦康奈尔本人呢？

sentences.en: Does he support this legislation that he's asking other Republicans to now support, and the same legislation that he so successfully blocked in 2015?
sentences.zh: 他是否支持这项他现在要求其他共和党人支持的立法，也就是他在2015年曾成功阻挠的那项立法？

sentences.en: So, that's actually one of the really fascinating questions that those of us reporting on this have been trying to figure out through this process.
sentences.zh: 这实际上是那些报道此事的我们一直在试图弄清楚的非常迷人的问题之一。

sentences.en: Senator McConnell has repeatedly said that he's not going to put his thumb personally on the scale one way or another on this bill.
sentences.zh: 麦康奈尔参议员多次表示，他个人不会在这项法案上施加任何影响。

sentences.en: That it's about how many Republicans can support it.
sentences.zh: 他说这取决于有多少共和党人能支持它。

sentences.en: Now we know there are enough that he's going to put it on the floor.
sentences.zh: 现在我们知道支持的人数足够多，他会将其提交表决。

sentences.en: But the interesting thing is what his personal considerations are.
sentences.zh: 但有趣的是他个人的考量是什么。

sentences.en: And he, as somebody who's up for re-election in 2020, he's one of the least popular senators in the country, given his position in leadership.
sentences.zh: 作为一名在2020年面临连任的人，考虑到他在领导层的地位，他是全国最不受欢迎的参议员之一。

sentences.en: And there's actually a lot of people who think he could end up voting for this bill that in the past he has helped derail,
sentences.zh: 实际上有很多人认为他最终可能会投票支持这项他过去曾帮助阻挠的法案，

sentences.en: in large part to give him a kind of bipartisan victory for his own re-election campaign.
sentences.zh: 很大程度上是为了给自己的连任竞选提供一场两党合作的胜利。

sentences.en: So, we could end up in a situation where, when this comes up on the floor for a vote next week, he says aye with a bunch of other Republicans.
sentences.zh: 所以，我们可能会出现这样一种情况：当下周这项法案提交表决时，他会和其他一众共和党人一起投下赞成票。

sentences.en: So, that seems like the ultimate sign of how much the politics around criminal justice reform have changed in the past few years.
sentences.zh: 这似乎是过去几年刑事司法改革政治环境发生巨大变化的终极标志。

sentences.en: That Mitch McConnell may now find himself needing to personally support this bill in order to survive in his own very red home state.
sentences.zh: 米奇·麦康奈尔现在可能发现自己需要亲自支持这项法案，才能在他自己那个非常红的家乡州生存下去。

sentences.en: Yeah.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: I mean, it's one of the great surprises of the last two years, I think, on Capitol Hill.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是过去两年国会山上最大的惊喜之一。

sentences.en: You know, I was talking to Senator Dick Durbin today.
sentences.zh: 你知道，我今天和迪克·德宾参议员谈过。

sentences.en: How important was having President Trump on board to this?
sentences.zh: 特朗普总统的支持对这件事有多重要？

sentences.en: It's been very helpful with the Republican votes.
sentences.zh: 这对争取共和党选票非常有帮助。

sentences.en: We had good support on the Democratic side going in, and some support on the Republican side, but the President's support has added to that.
sentences.zh: 我们一开始在民主党方面就有很好的支持，在共和党方面也有一些支持，但总统的支持增加了这种力量。

sentences.en: Do you think that President Trump gave Republicans and Senator McConnell the additional cover he needed to have a vote on this?
sentences.zh: 你认为特朗普总统给了共和党人和麦康奈尔参议员进行投票所需的额外掩护吗？

sentences.en: I think it made it easier.
sentences.zh: 我认为这让事情变得更容易了。

sentences.en: In a weird way, Trump is one of the elements that's made this possible, or is that overstating it?
sentences.zh: 从某种奇怪的角度来看，特朗普是促成此事的因素之一，还是说这种说法太夸张了？

sentences.en: It's like Nixon to China.
sentences.zh: 这就像尼克松访华一样。

sentences.en: When you have a president do something that seems out of political character, it can sometimes make an historic difference.
sentences.zh: 当一位总统做出某种看似不符合其政治性格的事情时，有时会产生历史性的影响。

sentences.en: And in this case, with the encouragement of his son-in-law, I might add, the president has really helped us.
sentences.zh: 在这种情况下，我还要补充一点，在女婿的鼓励下，总统确实帮助了我们。

sentences.en: That's kind of like the ultimate Democratic underhanded compliment, to, on the one hand, praise Trump for doing this, and in doing so, to compare him to Richardson.
sentences.zh: 这简直是民主党人最高级的反讽式恭维，一方面称赞特朗普做这件事，另一方面通过这种方式将他与尼克松相提并论。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: I mean, that was about as nice as Dick Durbin I think is ever going to get towards Donald Trump.
sentences.zh: 我的意思是，我认为这是迪克·德宾对唐纳德·特朗普所能表达的最客气的话了。

sentences.en: Nick, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 尼克，非常感谢你。

sentences.en: Thanks so much for having me.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢邀请我。

sentences.en: After the break, the bipartisan spirit on Capitol Hill Tuesday didn't last long.
sentences.zh: 休息之后，周二国会山上的两党精神并没有持续太久。

sentences.en: What I think we can agree on is we shouldn't shut down the government over a dispute.
sentences.zh: 我认为我们可以达成一致的是，我们不应该因为争端而让政府停摆。

sentences.en: And you want to shut it down.
sentences.zh: 而你却想让它停摆。

sentences.en: You keep talking about it.
sentences.zh: 你一直在谈论这件事。

sentences.en: The last time, Chuck, you shut it down.
sentences.zh: 上次，查克，是你让它停摆的。

sentences.en: No, no, no.
sentences.zh: 不，不，不。

sentences.en: And then you opened it up very quickly.
sentences.zh: 然后你很快就让它恢复了。

sentences.en: 20 times.
sentences.zh: 20次了。

sentences.en: I don't want to do what you did.
sentences.zh: 我不想做你做过的事。

sentences.en: 20 times you have called for, I will shut down the government if I don't get it.
sentences.zh: 你已经20次呼吁说，如果我得不到我想要的，我就要让政府停摆。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: The New York Times app?
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》应用程序？

sentences.en: Unlocked?
sentences.zh: 解锁了？

sentences.en: Everyone knows you need to subscribe to the Times to access all of the reporting.
sentences.zh: 大家都知道你需要订阅《时报》才能访问所有报道。

sentences.en: But what if you could explore the Times for a month, for free, without putting in a credit card?
sentences.zh: 但如果能免费试用《时报》一个月，且无需输入信用卡信息呢？

sentences.en: Now you can.
sentences.zh: 现在你可以了。

sentences.en: When you download the New York Times app for the first time, your first month in the app is free.
sentences.zh: 当你第一次下载《纽约时报》应用程序时，你在应用里的第一个月是免费的。

sentences.en: A month to go behind the paywall to see what Times subscribers get every single day.
sentences.zh: 用一个月的时间深入了解付费墙后的内容，看看《时报》订阅者每天都能获得什么。

sentences.en: If you don't already subscribe to the New York Times, download the Times app today and get free access for 30 days.
sentences.zh: 如果你还没有订阅《纽约时报》，今天就下载《时报》应用程序，免费获取30天的访问权限。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: OK, thank you very much.
sentences.zh: 好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: It's a great honor to have Nancy Pelosi with us and Chuck Schumer with us.
sentences.zh: 非常荣幸能有南希·佩洛西和查克·舒默与我们在一起。

sentences.en: And we've actually worked very hard on a couple of things that are happening.
sentences.zh: 我们实际上在几件正在发生的事情上做了非常努力的工作。

sentences.en: Criminal justice reform.
sentences.zh: 刑事司法改革。

sentences.en: We have a proposal that Democrats and Republicans will support to do a CR that will not shut down the government.
sentences.zh: 我们有一项民主党和共和党都会支持的提案，即通过一项持续决议案（CR），这样就不会让政府停摆。

sentences.en: We urge you to take it.
sentences.zh: 我们敦促你接受它。

sentences.en: And if it's not good border security, I won't take it.

sentences.en: And if it's not good border security, I won't take it.

sentences.en: During the meeting, the president refused to agree to fund the government without financing for a border wall, even if that meant a government shutdown.
sentences.zh: 会议期间，总统拒绝在没有边境墙资金的情况下同意为政府拨款，即使这意味着政府停摆。

sentences.en: You know what I'll say?
sentences.zh: 你知道我会说什么吗？

sentences.en: Yes.
sentences.zh: 是的。

sentences.en: If we don't get what we want, one way or the other, whether it's through you, through a military, through anything you want to call, I will shut down the government.
sentences.zh: 如果我们得不到我们想要的，无论通过什么方式，无论是通过你、通过军队，还是通过你想要的任何名义，我都会让政府停摆。

sentences.en: OK, fair enough.
sentences.zh: 好的，没问题。

sentences.en: And I am proud.
sentences.zh: 而且我很自豪。

sentences.en: And I'll tell you what.
